whoItsFor: Individuals who want a private personal AI assistant hosted in their own Cloudflare account, with chat, memory, tasks, notes and scheduled reminders. It is single-user and designed to fit Cloudflare's free tier.
useCases: Chat with a private AI assistant that remembers your preferences and facts
Manage tasks, notes and projects from the UI or by asking in chat
Set one-time or recurring reminders and daily task digests
